integrity: All displayed algebra in the explicit witness is checked by an exact-arithmetic standalone verifier. The infinite angle-only obstruction is proved analytically from the determinant formula, not inferred from finite sampling.
scientific_limitations: The exact criterion is local to one MatDL update under the secant-oriented system. The explicit quadratic proves existence of a strong-Wolfe-admissible step yielding ascent for the rho=1 and eta=1 variants; it does not assert that every line-search implementation selects that step or that the source's separate descent-oriented configurations fail.
title: An exact sufficient-descent boundary for secant-oriented Matrix Dai--Liao updates
